newsitem.title: BELARUS: Swiss firm to manage part of Belarus oil refinery.
newsitem.headline: Swiss firm to manage part of Belarus oil refinery.

text.p: Heritage Finance & Trust of Switzerland plans to manage in trust the state's share in the Mozyr oil refinery in Belarus, the head of the economy ministry's investment committee said on Tuesday.

"This big investment project, which could be fulfilled within the framework of a long-term cooperation programme, was signed last month in Switzerland by the company and the Belarussian leadership," committee chief Valery Drozd said.
He told Reuters the deal foresaw the Swiss company guaranteeing direct Western investment to rebuild the country's second refinery with an annual capacity of 320,000 barrels per day.

A delegation which arrived in Belarus on Monday from the Swiss company was to discuss the handover of the state's 42.75 percent in the plant. The Russian-Belarussian joint venture Slavneft also has a 42.57 percent share in the plant.
Drozd said the Swiss outfit had not named the size of any potential investment at preliminary talks but that it would be "tens of millions of dollars".
The government has said that $300 million are needed to reconstruct the plant in central Belarus.
"At the moment Heritage Finance & Trust's investment project is the most promising and the most convenient for the republic. Unlike other big investors, they are not demanding subsidies," Drozd said.
He said the two sides planned to form a joint venture which would sell output on Western markets.
